title: How much animation do the five core verbs get?
question: When the player clears, tills, plants, waters, or harvests — how much should the game act it out? Today the acted-on tile squashes and settles (the cheapest tier), and it's in the build. The next tier up animates the farmer's body per verb; the top tier is full per-verb choreography. The question the playtests should answer: can a player tell what her tap just did?
why_now: This was parked waiting on playtest evidence, and playtests have happened. An adult tester can say in words whether the feedback was clear — worth asking directly at the next session, or ruling from your own tablet time.

options.label: Stay at tile-reaction only
options.detail: What's in the build. Spend the art budget on the reskin instead.

options.label: Animate the farmer too
options.detail: A swing/pour/pull pose per verb on her sprite. Mid-cost; helps if testers can't tell what a tap did.

options.label: Full per-verb choreography
options.detail: The expensive tier — only if the game feels dead without it.

attachments.caption: The farmer today — walk cycle only, no per-verb poses
Till — sound carries part of the feedback
